name: Moped
description: A motor vehicle that's a limited-speed motorcycle under the federal Motor Vehicle Safety Regulations, propelled by an electric motor or an engine of 50 cc or less: a top speed of 70 km/h or less and a seat at least 650 mm high. An electric moped or scooter past the power bicycle limits lands here whatever its motor power, while one able to exceed 70 km/h is a motorcycle.

restrictions.rule: An electric motor of any power, or an engine of no more than 50 cc
restrictions.citation: Use of Highway and Rules of the Road Regulation, Alta. Reg. 304/2002, s. 1(1)(i)

restrictions.rule: A limited-speed motorcycle: no more than three wheels, a maximum speed of 70 km/h or less, a driver's seat at least 650 mm high, and no structure enclosing the rider
restrictions.citation: Use of Highway and Rules of the Road Regulation, Alta. Reg. 304/2002, s. 1(1)(i); Motor Vehicle Safety Regulations, C.R.C., c. 1038, s. 2(1)

restrictions.rule: Riders need an operator's licence of any class; a Class 7 licence, issued from age 14, isn't treated as a learner's licence on a moped
restrictions.citation: Operator Licensing and Vehicle Control Regulation, Alta. Reg. 320/2002, ss. 25, 26, 28 and 32

restrictions.rule: Rider and passenger must wear a helmet meeting a motorcycle helmet standard
restrictions.citation: Vehicle Equipment Regulation, Alta. Reg. 122/2009, ss. 107 and 108

restrictions.rule: Riders under 16 may not carry passengers
restrictions.citation: Use of Highway and Rules of the Road Regulation, Alta. Reg. 304/2002, s. 76

restrictions.rule: Must be registered, plated and insured
restrictions.citation: Traffic Safety Act, R.S.A. 2000, c. T-6, ss. 52 to 54

restrictions.rule: Needs lamps lit whenever it's on a highway, a left side mirror, reflectors and a brake on each wheel
restrictions.citation: Use of Highway and Rules of the Road Regulation, Alta. Reg. 304/2002, s. 55(2); Vehicle Equipment Regulation, Alta. Reg. 122/2009, ss. 50, 54 and 110

restrictions.rule: Ridden as near as practicable to the right edge of the roadway, and on the paved shoulder where there is one
restrictions.citation: Use of Highway and Rules of the Road Regulation, Alta. Reg. 304/2002, s. 77

restrictions.rule: Not a motorcycle or power bicycle
restrictions.citation: Traffic Safety Act, R.S.A. 2000, c. T-6, s. 1(1)(w) and (x)
